title: A first renewal never compared its time with the rotation's deadline, so before the sweep the old bearer could still renew and escape the revocation at the cap
resolution: The registry reads the service clock after the row lock and the renewal step refuses a first renewal at or after the deadline as forbidden, which the API answers 401; tests cover a late renewal before the sweep and one that waited on the lock.

title: A notice for the generation after an adopted but unconfirmed one was acknowledged and dropped, so after a lost confirmation answer or a cap sweep the worker never renewed it
resolution: The worker stores the pending file of that generation before the acknowledgement, confirms the adopted generation first, and then renews the stored one; a test covers a lost confirmation answer followed by the next rotation.

title: A confirmation after the deadline but before the sweep was recorded as confirmed instead of the required expiry with reason unconfirmed
resolution: At or after the deadline, read after the row lock, the confirmation first applies the cap's predecessor expiry and then answers as a repeat; tests cover both orders of confirmation and sweep.

title: A repeated confirmation reported its revocations as published without publishing, while the broker still refused the earlier publication
resolution: Every confirmation, a repeat included, publishes the recorded revocations and reports that result; a regression test keeps the broker failing across the repeat.

title: The finish of an adoption dropped the predecessor from the identity before it removed the old files, so a crash between the steps left old secrets on disk for good
resolution: The identity is the durable record: every worker start with no kept predecessor removes the files of the generation before the current one and its pending file; tests cover a crash after the identity replacement and after partial removals.

title: The worker driver retried only an unavailable renewal or confirmation, so one 500 left the pending generation unrenewed until a new notice or link, and the cap then revoked the worker
resolution: Only a 400, 401 or 403, or 409 is a refusal; any other failure, a 500 included, is retried after the launch retry delay for both the renewal and the confirmation; the spec, design, and installation contract name the refusals.

title: The worker credential scheme said a bearer past its rotation's deadline is refused, while the current generation of an unrenewed rotation authenticates until the sweep revokes the worker
resolution: The scheme and both 401 descriptions of the OpenAPI document now refuse a predecessor dropped by a confirmation or past the deadline; a new installation-enrollment scenario states that the current generation authenticates until the sweep.

title: The AsyncAPI description listed only the confirmation and the heartbeat as sent without a message id, omitting the inventory request and the rotation notice
resolution: The description and the wire contracts guide list all four headerless messages; make contract-compatibility reports no new breaking change and the document stays 0.8.0.

title: A refused renewal was logged only as an API request line without the worker or the reason, so a renewal mismatch could not be attributed, and no test covered the log-only rule
resolution: The renewal handler logs fleet.credentials.renewal-refused with the worker, the generation, the code, and the reason for a 400, 401, or 409, never a key or hash; a test and a spec scenario cover it.

title: The removal of a superseded generation's files threw on a file system error instead of returning a failure, so it escaped the worker start unstructured
resolution: Each removal is caught and returned as a flush-failure root failure naming the path; a test puts a directory at a predecessor file's path.

title: The record said the other modified requirements were on capabilities that dev did not change, but dev changed execution-wire-contracts
resolution: The record now says requirements that dev did not change and names that dev changed execution-wire-contracts but not its Worker channels requirement, which the git diff of the merge confirms.

title: The modified Worker channels requirement also added the inventory request to the living text without declaring it
resolution: The proposal and the record declare that the requirement also names the inventory request, which the AsyncAPI command channel already carries.

title: The added requirement named only the rotation notice while it also defines the two HTTP credential operations
resolution: The requirement is renamed Credential rotation contracts in the delta, the proposal, and the record; strict validation and the archive dry run pass.

title: The fleet module had two types for the rotation order and two names for the renewal request and answer
resolution: One RotationOrder, CredentialRenewalRequest, and RenewedCredentials in the fleet domain, with the wire field names, serve the registry, the service, the client port, and the worker.

title: The worker hashed its new bearer with its own SHA-256 call instead of the hash function the control plane compares with
resolution: The worker hashes with the same NodeSecrets instance that issues the bearer, the hashOf the control plane uses.

title: The catch-up path of an offline worker silently depended on the command stream's maximum age covering the rotation deadline
resolution: The design and the operational targets record the dependency, and a test asserts the maximum age is at least the deadline; a full stream or backlog only delays the notice, since the streams discard new messages and the outbox retries.
